sections.heading: Electronic signature is rejected
sections.text: Electronic signatures require users to re-enter their own sign-in password in the signature dialog. Signatures are rejected if the password is mistyped, if the account is locked, or if no signing reason is selected.

steps.text: Ask the user to select a signing reason from the list before entering their password.
Ask the user to retry the signature carefully, checking that Caps Lock is off.

information_needed.prompt: The document name as shown in the site binder.
The date and time of the failed attempt.

stop_conditions.text: Never ask the user to share their password with support. If the signature still fails, stop and escalate to L2 with the attempt time.
